definitions.explanation: Completely wet through, typically from rain or immersion in water.

examples.english: I got soaking wet from the rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧、ずぶ{濡|ぬ}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot my umbrella and came home soaking wet.

examples.japanese: ずぶ{濡|ぬ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着替|きが}えた→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧。
examples.english: I changed out of my soaking wet clothes.

notes:
USAGE: ずぶ{濡|ぬ}れ emphasizes being completely soaked through, more extreme than just being wet.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- As a noun: ずぶ{濡|ぬ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧＋noun (soaking wet ~)
- With ⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: ずぶ{濡|ぬ}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become soaking wet)
- With ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: ずぶ{濡|ぬ}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧＋verb (do something while soaking wet)
- ずぶ{濡|ぬ}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to get drenched)
- ずぶ{濡|ぬ}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (drenched state)

NUANCE: The prefix ずぶ is an intensifier meaning "completely" or "thoroughly," similar to びしょ in ⟦びしょ{濡|ぬ}れ→びしょ濡れ：16748_bishonure⟧.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦びしょ{濡|ぬ}れ→びしょ濡れ：16748_bishonure⟧ - sopping wet (similar intensity)
- ⟦{濡|ぬ}れる→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧ - to get wet (verb)
